page.overview:
Who is Declan Milder?

Declan Milder was a Starfleet officer who served as an engineer aboard the in the mid-23rd century.

At Starfleet Academy, Milder beat Montgomery Scott for valedictorian by one-sixteenth of a point. He also had a more cordial relationship with Pelia than Scott, which Scott claimed was because they were "the same kind of bananas."

As of 2262, Milder held the record for farthest transported object, at approximately 25,000 kilometers. Scott sought to beat his record, and scare him, by beaming his childhood puppet, Little Ricky, almost 30,000 kilometers from the to Milder's quarters on the Witmere. However, his attempt instead caused a transporter accident that rendered Lieutenant Spock unconscious for several hours.

While unconscious, Spock had a vivid dream in which the accident transformed the entire Enterprise crew into puppets. With the ship in puppet-induced crisis, Pelia repeatedly taunted Scott by telling him Declan would have done better, until Scott invented a glove that mimicked the electro-pulse of Human skin. She then assured him that Milder was a "crybaby" and a legacy student whose parents sat on the board. ()
